retail.name: Retail shops
retail.desc: Clothing, homewares, gifts, hardware, florists and other shops
profile: Goods shipped to customers by courier?

gen: Online sales and delivery
Stock in transit to customers, courier cover and returns. Check the carrier’s limits and whether the policy covers goods you have sold but not yet delivered.
cyber: Card data, website security and what happens if the website or POS is down in the busiest week.

grocery.name: Dairies, supermarkets and convenience
grocery.desc: Dairies, superettes, supermarkets, bottle stores and convenience stores
profile: Sell alcohol, and hold an off-licence?
Ram raid, aggravated robbery or burglary claims in the last 5 years?
Lotto, parcel or money transfer services offered?

gen: Robbery, burglary and ram raids
Dairies and bottle stores are frequent targets. Ask about shop front protection, bollards, cameras, alarm response and what staff are told to do in a robbery.
Refrigeration and spoilage
Loss of chilled and frozen stock from breakdown or power failure. Check alarms, backup power and the policy limit.
crime: Ask what support is given to staff, and the cover for cash in transit, money on premises and damage to the building after a break-in.

cafe.name: Cafes, restaurants and takeaways
cafe.desc: Cafes, restaurants, takeaway shops, bakeries and food trucks
profile: Delivery by staff or delivery platforms?

gen: Lease and fit-out
Who owns the building? Fit-out, signage, glass and outdoor furniture usually fall to the tenant. Check the lease insurance clauses.
Equipment
Coffee machines, ovens, cool rooms and POS hardware. Replacement values and breakdown cover.
bi: Hospitality often needs 12 months or more because of fit-out and consents. Consider public authority closure and loss of power or water.
liab: Delivery drivers on bikes and in cars, footpath tables and heaters. Council permits can require a minimum liability limit.

pubbar.name: Pubs, bars and nightclubs
pubbar.desc: Pubs, taverns, bars, nightclubs and licensed venues
profile: Licensed door staff or crowd controllers?

gen: Security and door staff
Are crowd controllers employees or contracted? Check their licences, the contractor’s insurance and incident records.
Earthquake-prone and heritage buildings
Older town-centre buildings often carry earthquake-prone notices or heritage listing. Check seismic status and rebuild cost.
liab: Injuries from glassware and fights. ACC covers injury in NZ, so check what the policy responds to: defence costs, property damage and exemplary damages.
crime: Cash, tills, safes and gaming proceeds. Check banking routines and employee dishonesty cover.
bi: Loss of a licence or an enforced closure stops trading without damage to the building. Ask what the policy responds to.

accommodation.name: Motels, hotels and holiday parks
accommodation.desc: Motels, hotels, backpackers, B&Bs, holiday parks and lodges

gen: Seasonality and peak values
Occupancy, tariffs and income peak by season. Gross revenue should reflect peak trading and the indemnity period should cover a rebuild.
Fire safety and evacuation
Smoke detection, sprinklers, evacuation scheme and building warrant of fitness. Older motels often have sleeping risk concerns.
liab: Guests’ belongings, pool and spa safety, and slips and falls. Check liability for guests’ property and the sub-limit.
Long-stay, boarding or emergency housing use changes the risk. Ask about the mix and agreements.
mdamage: Furniture, appliances, linen and soft furnishings. Check replacement values and theft by guests.

motor.name: Motor trade
motor.desc: Vehicle dealers, mechanics, panel beaters, tyre shops, auto-electricians

mtrade.name: Motor Trade
mtrade.desc: Stock, road risk and customers’ vehicles
q: Peak value of stock held at any one site

q.hint: The highest value in the year, not the average.

q: Value of vehicles held on consignment
Customers’ vehicles in your care at peak (value)
Hail or flood exposure at the yard
Theft or damage claims in the last 3 years?

profile: Authorised to issue WOF or CoF?

liab: Hoists and lifts inspected and certified?
Fuel, oil or solvents stored on site?
mdamage: Spray booth or paint mixing room?

gen: Licences and registration
Is the business a registered motor vehicle trader, and do any staff hold WOF or CoF authority? A lapse or suspension affects cover and liability.
Consumer law exposure
Consumer Guarantees Act and Fair Trading Act claims on used vehicles: odometer accuracy, undisclosed damage and sold-as-described issues.
Finance and ownership checks
Do you check the Personal Property Securities Register before buying stock? Vehicles with finance owing are a common loss.
mtrade: Is it the peak stock value, not the average? Include consignment, vehicles in transit and those offsite for repair or detailing.
Who can drive trade plated or demo vehicles? Check licence class, age limits, excess for young drivers and unaccompanied test drives.
Peak value of customer vehicles in the workshop or yard. Are they covered for fire, theft and damage, and what excess applies?
Where is stock parked? Hail has caused large dealer losses. Consider covered parking, hail limit and excess, and flood zones.
Keys secured overnight? Fencing, CCTV, alarm monitoring, trackers and immobilisers. Unlocked vehicles and left keys can lead to declined claims.
liab: Brakes, steering, tyres and structural repairs. Is work warranted, and what happens after a crash blamed on a repair?
Oil, fuel and solvent spills. Clean-up cost is often excluded or sub-limited.
fleet: Make sure vehicles used day to day are insured on the correct section and not left to trade plate cover.

servicestation.name: Service stations and fuel retailers
servicestation.desc: Petrol stations, fuel distributors and convenience forecourts
profile: Car wash, workshop or tyre services on site?

liab: Leaks from tanks, pipework and spills at the forecourt. Check pollution cover, tank testing records and site contamination history.
Customers filling the wrong fuel or contaminated fuel. Check supplier agreements and the policy’s product wording.
mdamage: Fuel dispensers, LPG, electrical systems and shop fires. Ask about emergency shut-offs, suppression and inspection certificates.
crime: Fuel theft, robbery and cash holding. Ask about prepay, cameras and staff safety procedures.

courier.name: Couriers, freight and trucking
courier.desc: Couriers, owner-drivers, trucking, freight and delivery

gen: Owner-drivers and contractors
Who insures the vehicles and the goods? Check contractor agreements, driver status and insurance certificates.
Driver hours and fatigue
Work time and logbook compliance, rest breaks and fatigue management. Check regulatory history.
cargo: Carrier’s liability and goods in transit
Standard conditions of carriage limit liability. Check the limit per consignment, high-risk goods, temperature-controlled loads and customers’ expectations.
Parcels left unattended or vehicles parked overnight. Check security conditions and theft exclusions.
fleet: Values, ages, tracking, driver licences and claims history. Check loading, trailers and towing.

passenger.name: Taxis, shuttles and passenger transport
passenger.desc: Taxis, rideshare, buses, shuttles and tourism transport
profile: Drivers hold passenger endorsements and are checked?
School runs or children as passengers?
Work through rideshare or booking platforms?

gen: Driver licensing and checks
Passenger service licence, driver endorsements, licence checks and police vetting. Check training and monitoring.
Platform cover gaps
Rideshare platforms cover only certain periods. Check what the policy covers while logged on, waiting and not carrying a passenger.
liab: ACC covers injury but not all losses. Check passenger liability, property damage, loss of baggage and exemplary damages.
fleet: Warrant of fitness, certificate of fitness, maintenance records, tracking and dash cameras.

warehouse.name: Warehousing and logistics
warehouse.desc: Warehouses, cold stores, freight forwarding and distribution
profile: Value of goods held for others at peak

liab: Goods held for others are your responsibility under the contract. Check the limit, the basis of liability and the contracts with owners.
Racking collapse and forklift accidents are a major exposure. Ask about inspections, load limits and driver training.
mdamage: Large stock values in one building. Ask about sprinklers, fire walls, aisles and hot work controls.
Cold stores and refrigerated goods. Check alarms, backup power and the limit for loss of stock.
